title: Smoked Prosciutto Menemen
description: A twist on the classic Turkish menemen with smoky prosciutto and a French flair.

ingredients.name: Menemen Spice Mix
ingredients.notes: Available at most Middle Eastern markets

instructions: Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the smoked prosciutto and cook until crispy, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the chopped parsley and cook until wilted.
Crack in the eggs and cook until the whites are set.
Sprinkle the shredded Turkish cheese and cook until melted.
Season with salt, pepper, and menemen spice mix.
